days.file: Jacopo Tintoretto - Christ in the House of Martha and Mary - WGA22615.jpg
days.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
days.alt: Martha leans over the table and points toward her sister Mary, who sits on the floor near Jesus as He speaks.
days.look: Look again at Martha’s pointing hand. What has been pulling you away from sitting with Jesus?
days.license: Artist died 1594; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jean-François Millet - The Sower - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Sower
days.alt: A farmer strides down a dark hillside at dusk, flinging seed from the bag at his side.
days.look: Look again at the seed leaving the sower’s hand. Can you trust God with what grows from it?
days.license: Artist died 1875; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Juan de Flandes - The Marriage Feast at Cana - WGA12055.jpg
days.title: The Marriage Feast at Cana
days.place: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
days.alt: At the wedding table in Cana, Jesus and Mary sit while a servant pours water from a jug, with the stone jars below.
days.look: Look again at the servant pouring water. What ordinary task is yours to do faithfully today?
days.license: Artist died 1519; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jean-François Millet - The Angelus - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: The Angelus
days.alt: Two farm workers stand in an evening field with heads bowed in prayer, their fork and basket at their feet.
days.look: Look again at the tools laid down for prayer. Which task will you offer to God in His name today?
days.license: Artist died 1875; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Gerard van Honthorst - King David Playing the Harp - Google Art Project.jpg
days.title: King David Playing the Harp
days.alt: King David, crowned, looks up to heaven as he plays a harp.
days.look: Look again at David’s eyes, lifted above the harp. To whom is your music or work really offered?
days.license: Artist died 1656; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Dieric Bouts - Prophet Elijah in the Desert - WGA03015.jpg
days.title: The Prophet Elijah in the Desert
days.alt: An angel kneels beside the prophet Elijah, asleep in the desert, and gently touches his shoulder.
days.look: Look again at the angel’s hand on the sleeping prophet. Where is God inviting you to rest and be fed?
days.license: Artist died 1475; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Paul in Prison
days.alt: St. Paul, old and bearded, sits in a prison cell with his hand to his chin and a book on his knees, as light falls through the window.
days.look: Look again at the light falling on Paul in his cell. Which weakness would you let God’s grace shine on?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Pieter Bruegel the Elder - The Corn Harvest (August) - WGA03451.jpg
days.title: The Harvesters
days.place: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
days.alt: Harvesters swing their scythes and bundle sheaves in a field of golden wheat.
days.look: Look again at the harvesters in the wide field. Who is the Lord asking you to pray for today?
days.license: Artist died 1569; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Ghent Altarpiece: Singing Angels
days.alt: A choir of angels in rich robes sings together from a book on a carved lectern.
days.look: Look again at the angels singing together. For which grace of these days will you give God glory?
days.license: Artists died 1441 and 1426; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: PD-Art)
